verse: She navigates to the updater page, which asks for a password. Upon correct submission of her password, she uses an intuitive web forms interface to update the game to her desiring.

title: Reliability shall be ensured by extensive testing by team members and mentors, if available
description: Reliability shall be ensured by extensive testing by team members and mentors, if available.
acceptance_criteria: The project includes testing activities performed by team members.
If mentors are available, mentors participate in testing activities.
Testing is used as the stated means of ensuring product reliability.

verse: Reliability will be ensured by extensive testing by the team members and mentors, if available.

title: Maintainability as a primary project goal
description: The product shall treat maintainability as a primary goal for the project.
acceptance_criteria: The SRS identifies maintainability as a primary goal for the product.
Project artifacts for the product reflect maintainability as a stated quality attribute.

verse: Maintainability is a primary goal for this project.

title: Use sub-scenes to split code in the main Flash game
description: The main Flash game shall use appropriate sub-scenes to split up the code.
acceptance_criteria: The main Flash game is organized into sub-scenes.
The sub-scenes are used to divide the game's code rather than keeping it in one undivided scene.
The sub-scene structure is present within the main Flash game.

verse: using appropriate sub-scenes in the main Flash game to split up the code

title: Use appropriate sub-scenes to split up the code for easier later alteration
description: Using appropriate sub-scenes in the main Flash game shall split up the code to allow easier alteration at a later date.
acceptance_criteria: The main Flash game uses appropriate sub-scenes to split up the code.
The code organization supports easier alteration at a later date.

verse: using appropriate sub-scenes in the main Flash game to split up the code will allow for easy alteration at a later date
